name: Aqua
description: Pinku uses oriental fantasy themes to create the legendary story of Tianyinxian: In the Nine Heavens Immortal World, Tianyin Xianzun, who is in charge of the thirty-six orchestras in the heaven, collects a Tianyin Stone that contains mysterious energy. Legend has it that touching the spirit stone can produce two completely different sounds of nature. The Tianyin Stone was lost in a battle between immortals and demons. During this period, it was struck by lightning. One of the stones fell into the Linyue Lake of Ten Thousand Years of Xuanbing and transformed into the shape of a pipa, named Lianying. It emerges from the world and is as pure and clear as the spring water of Linyue Lake. It evokes clear and sweet sounds, like jade beads running on the disk and the sound of mountain streams and springs, washing away the hustle and bustle of the world and calming the restlessness of all things.
